title: The US-R1-001 bullet cites `scripts/cam/review-artifact.txt sections 4-5` as it…
body: The US-R1-001 bullet cites `scripts/cam/review-artifact.txt sections 4-5` as its evidence pointer, but that file is ephemeral and gitignored (.gitignore:81) and is overwritten by every subsequent review round; it is not tracked on main. patterns.md is by contract durable and versioned on main, so this cross-reference is unresolvable for any future reader. The bullet already states the measured facts inline ('measured: two criteria in US-001's own acceptanceCriteria, patterns.md keyword-density and CLAUDE.md placement, both did this against unmodified main'), so the citation is supplementary rather than load-bearing. Consider dropping the pointer or replacing it with the CAM issue number, which is durable.

title: Carried forward from review round 1 (not adopted, non-blocking): criterion 2 ha…
body: Carried forward from review round 1 (not adopted, non-blocking): criterion 2 hardcodes the magic number 897 as main's patterns.md line count (`test ... -gt 897`). Verified still correct today (main's patterns.md is exactly 897 lines) and the oracle was confirmed red on main, so it is not a defect. It would silently become wrong if another PRD appends to patterns.md before this branch merges; deriving the baseline via `git show main:scripts/cam/patterns.md | wc -l` would keep the append-at-EOF intent load-bearing across rebases.
